sourceRefs.locator: Pars posterior 53–56. Camp in the Pineta, reported price of a measure of wheat, difficulties during the siege, entry into Ravenna and Odoacer’s death.
Part 1, pp. 19–21, entries for Italy under 489, 490, 492 and 493. Verona, the siege of Ravenna and the additional naval blockade from 492.

processingNote.de: Die Fläche umfasst schematisch Ravenna und das nahe Umfeld zur Adria. Der Pinienwald und die Zugänge über See erscheinen in unterschiedlichen Phasen der Belagerung. Ihr genauer Verlauf ist offen.
processingNote.en: The outline schematically includes Ravenna and the nearby approaches towards the Adriatic. The pine wood and access by sea feature at different stages of the siege. Their precise extent remains open.
